# Narration audio

* `source/` – the four supplied ElevenLabs recordings, untouched (named `.wav`, MP3 data inside).
* `en/`, `fr/` – mastered, pause-aligned segments generated by `npm run audio:align` (`scene-01..06.wav` for the full videos, `teaser-01..03.wav` for the teasers).
* `alignment.json` – cut points, durations and speech intervals used for placement and subtitles.
* `ALIGNMENT.md` – the synchronization report (`npm run audio:report`).

See `video/README.md` for how to replace a recording.
